identity.title: Move remaining P1 responsibilities out of WPF Views and revalidate protected partial boundaries

origin.kind: explicit user request to refactor the three P1 View boundaries and schedule the protected Partial review
origin.summary: The WPF View audit identified Recipe run evidence file/Bitmap decoding, Line Tool persistence, and RoiImageCanvasViewModel UI/native/path coupling as remaining P1 responsibility candidates. The user explicitly requested these boundaries and an additional review of the existing 59 protected partial declarations.

state.current_summary: PL-0027 is resolved. M1-M5 are verified: Recipe evidence image decoding, Line Tool persistence, RoiImageCanvas boundary proof, row-level structural review of all 59 Partial declarations with the ROI/template decode extraction, and final owner-map/static/build/contract verification. The retained XAML/generated/native/test boundaries have explicit owners and are not pending mechanical merging. WPF visual/theme/DPI/monitor/input, GPU/camera/SDK, and long-running native shutdown remain explicitly unverified.

objective.summary: Reduce the three confirmed P1 View responsibility conflicts with the smallest existing concrete owners, then revalidate all 59 Partial declarations without cosmetic file movement or new abstraction layers.
constraints: Work only in C:\Git\2D\Dev; keep C:\Git\2D\Original read-only.
Preserve XAML names, binding/public contracts, Recipe/XML behavior, Preview/Run behavior, image ownership, cancellation, shutdown, and PropertyGrid contracts.
Reuse existing concrete controllers, presenters, factories, image/resource owners, and ImageCanvas policies before creating a new class.
Do not add one-implementation interfaces, managers, providers, factories, forwarding wrappers, or manual partials without an independently owned state/lifetime/test seam.
One heartbeat may complete one independently verifiable responsibility only; do not wait for optional user input or runtime hardware.
Do not commit, push, tag, release, deploy, or modify C:\Git\2D\Original from scheduled work.
Partial declarations already classified as generated/framework/cohesive protected boundaries may remain unchanged when current proof still holds.

criteria.text: Recipe run evidence file/Bitmap decode has a concrete owner outside the View, the View retains only presentation/lifecycle responsibilities, old direct file decode coupling is removed, and the existing evidence/error/Dispose contract is verified.

Line Tool property persistence is owned by an existing concrete tool session/controller boundary or a directly justified concrete owner, the View no longer performs storage policy, and the existing preset/property-change behavior is verified.

RoiImageCanvasViewModel has a proven state/input/native/path boundary decision. Any extraction moves real ownership and preserves Mat/Bitmap/input/dialog/Dispose contracts; if no boundary is safe, a current proof records the no-change decision.

All current Partial declarations are inventoried and classified against the latest source. Generated/framework/cohesive declarations retain evidence, and any reopened declaration has an explicit owner/call-path/dependency/lifetime proof.

Each accepted source slice passes its focused contract/build/static checks, updates the live handoff and owner map, and records unverified WPF runtime/hardware/long-run boundaries without overclaiming.

artifacts.summary: Focused source/build/contract evidence for the three P1 owners and Partial revalidation.

evidence.observation: Recipe evidence View no longer contains FileStream or Image.FromStream; the existing OpenVisionBitmapImagePreviewFactory owns LoadBitmap and the View routes through it.
RecipeRunEvidenceImageBoundaryContract passed 4/4, including valid dimensions and role-specific missing-file failure text.

LineToolWpfView no longer references OpenVisionNativeToolPropertySessionStore or PersistLineProperties. LineToolPresenter exposes PersistProperties and the existing composition factory keeps Line(L)_1 and Line(R)_1 saves.
LineToolPersistenceBoundaryContract passed 3/3; VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke Debug build completed with zero warnings and zero errors.

RoiImageCanvasViewModel delegates input, dialog/context, directory, image load, and image save policy to existing concrete owners; it retains the shared ROI/state/native control lifetime contract and known consumers dispose it.

RoiImageCanvasBoundaryContract passed 6/6 and VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke Debug build completed with zero warnings and zero errors. The contract verifies no direct modal/file-encoding policy, explicit Mat/native release, host attach/detach, and consumer Dispose paths.

The latest source inventory contains 59 compiled Partial declarations. Every row has a current caller, mutable-state writer, lifetime/release owner, binding/public/test contract, and disposition; retained declarations are tied to generated/framework, native, test, composition, or cohesive visual boundaries.

TemplateEditorImageBoundaryContract passed 3/3 and the VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke Debug build completed with 0 warnings and 0 errors. Both ROI editor Views route pattern image decoding through the existing image factory and no longer contain direct path/file Bitmap construction.

The final static gates passed: RefactorAudit reports 59 Partial declarations, 2 literal text matches, 0 project cycles, and 0 Shell storage calls; TestDocumentationIndex passed 295 indexed paths, 16 routes, and 102 root redirects; git diff --check exited 0.

Solution Debug/Release builds and VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke Debug/Release builds completed with 0 warnings and 0 errors. Recipe evidence, Line persistence, RoiImageCanvas, and ROI/template image contracts passed 4/4, 3/3, 6/6, and 3/3 in both configurations.

events.summary: Reuse the existing single heartbeat executor and process one P1 owner per slice.
